purpose: Machine-checkable custody contract for H1a/H1b procedural-transfer task sets. Actual protected manifests remain evaluator custody until disclosure is scientifically safe.
custody_invariants: base repository passes full frozen evaluator before mutation
mutated repository fails at least one full frozen evaluator obligation
family label, mutation receipt, protected tests and reference repair are solver-hidden
task_id, mutated_repo_digest and task_statement_digest are globally unique
DEVELOPMENT and PROTECTED exact repository/task digests are disjoint
PROTECTED exposed identifiers do not appear in DEVELOPMENT exposed identifiers except frozen generic allowlist
PROTECTED mutation/reference repair digests never appear in DEVELOPMENT exposed_artifact_digests
all protected tests and mutation/reference receipts are bound by digest before solving arms run
scoring_boundary: fault_files/fault_regions are used evaluator-side only for frozen localization scoring after traces exist; they are never solver context
